name: Plot bands topomap
summary: Plots scalp topographies of power spectral density in canonical frequency bands (delta to gamma) from MEG epochs with MNE-Python plot_psd_topomap, for gradiometers and magnetometers.
description: Visualisation utility: computes PSD band topomaps from an MNE epochs file with fixed bands (delta 0-4, theta 4-8, alpha 8-12 Hz and higher bands) and saves one PNG for gradiometers and one for magnetometers. Use it for a quick look at the spatial distribution of band power in MEG epochs.

inputs.description: MNE epochs file (-epo.fif) of MEG data.

outputs.description: PNG topomaps of band power for gradiometers and magnetometers.

citations.text: Hayashi S, Caron BA, et al., Pestilli F. brainlife.io: A decentralized and open source cloud platform to support neuroscience research. arXiv (2023).
Gramfort A, et al. MEG and EEG data analysis with MNE-Python. Front Neurosci 7:267 (2013).
